ten4sevenOwns: keyboard, focus, dismissal, and touch behavior
semantic feedback tone, urgency, and persistence presentation
consumerOwns: guards, permissions, entitlements, and effective access
notification data, persistence, and event source
connectivity, retry, sync, and business truth

focus.meaning: focus feedback above the owning surface

focusDismissal.presentationRoot: One renderer-owned presentation root; floating content may remain inside an open modal dialog to preserve scoped tokens and clipping boundaries.

modal.initialFocus: renderer focuses the supplied target or the first usable control
modal.containment: focus remains within the active modal task surface
modal.returnFocus: dismissal returns focus to the invoking control when it remains connected
modal.scroll: renderer owns underlay scroll locking for active modal depth

nonModal.returnFocus: interactive menus and popovers return to their trigger
nonModal.scroll: the owning page remains scrollable unless the renderer surface says otherwise

focusDismissal.nesting: The active top layer receives dismissal first; an inner popup closes before its owning modal or drawer.
focusDismissal.safeArea: Native renderers resolve safe-area insets; Web uses the existing semantic safe-area variables.

Disclosure.reason: The generic open/closed disclosure intent is already represented by Collapsible.
Disclosure.aiGuidance: Use Collapsible for one region; use Accordion for a collection. Do not create a Disclosure wrapper per product.

TreeDisclosure.reason: Hierarchy expansion owns level, position, and selection semantics that Accordion does not.
TreeDisclosure.aiGuidance: Use TreeView for hierarchy disclosure; do not flatten tree expansion into Accordion.

Menubar.reason: The current canonical menu engine supports bounded dropdown and context actions; persistent hierarchical desktop menubar behavior needs a separate bounded proof.
Menubar.aiGuidance: Use NavigationMenu or DropdownMenu for current coverage. Do not invent a local menubar.

Menu.reason: Menu is the shared action-item contract underneath DropdownMenu and ContextMenu, not a third visual primitive.
Menu.aiGuidance: Use DropdownMenu for a trigger-attached action menu and ContextMenu for contextual invocation.

Sheet.reason: Drawer already owns edge-attached surface mechanics; bottom placement is a semantic presentation variant sharing the same overlay engine.
Sheet.aiGuidance: Use Drawer with the appropriate side/presentation. Do not create a second Sheet runtime.

BottomSheet.reason: Native bottom-sheet presentation is a renderer strategy for Drawer, not a separate Web primitive.
BottomSheet.aiGuidance: Use Drawer intent with a Native bottom-sheet renderer when the platform calls for it.

HoverCard.reason: Rich preview content needs a bounded content contract and a deliberate press alternative before implementation.
HoverCard.aiGuidance: Use Popover for interactive anchored content. Do not fake hover-only behavior on Native.

Snackbar.reason: Snackbar is the platform presentation name for the same transient feedback intent.
Snackbar.aiGuidance: Use Toast semantics; Native may render the same event as a platform Snackbar.

InlineNotice.reason: The existing Alert owns persistent in-context feedback; emphasis and tone are presentation choices.
InlineNotice.aiGuidance: Use Alert for local notices instead of creating a product-specific notice primitive.

LoadingState.reason: Loading grammar is already covered by Spinner, Skeleton, and the module-state plane.
LoadingState.aiGuidance: Choose Spinner or Skeleton for local work and ModuleState for module lifecycle; do not create LoadingState by route.

ErrorState.reason: StateView already covers recoverable error presentation with consumer-owned retry action.
ErrorState.aiGuidance: Use StateView for a screen state or Alert for local recovery; keep error truth with the consumer.

StatusIndicator.reason: StatusChip already provides compact non-color status presentation.
StatusIndicator.aiGuidance: Use StatusChip for compact state and a feedback component when a message or recovery action is needed.

InfiniteScroll.reason: Incremental collection loading is a U07 collection concern and must not be mixed into Pagination.
InfiniteScroll.aiGuidance: Use Pagination for bounded pages; defer infinite loading to the collection contract.

compatibility: Modal remains exported as a compatibility wrapper for Dialog.
ActionMenu remains the existing alias of DropdownMenu.
Snackbar, InlineNotice, LoadingState, ErrorState, and StatusIndicator remain semantic variants rather than parallel primitives.
ActivityFeed remains a data/audit feed; NotificationCenter owns persisted inspectable event presentation.
Native renderers may choose drawer, sheet, snackbar, or screen presentation while preserving shared intent and state vocabulary.
